name: c2-reference
cmd:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
tar -xf port-input/base.tar -C "$root"
(cd port-input/bundle && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
bash port-input/bundle/materialize-reference.sh "$root"
printf 'C2_REFERENCE_TAR '
tar -czf - -C "$root" core/count-lifted-replacement.ts core/count-lifted-increment.ts core/count-stabilize-tree.ts core/count-case-compose.ts research/track-m/prove-boolean-partition-cut.ts research/track-m/transport-count-lemmas.ts | base64 -w0
printf '\n'
printf 'C2_REFERENCE_MATERIALIZED\n'
